summary: Backend-only testing for new GET /api/admin/analytics endpoint. Created /app/backend/tests/test_analytics.py with 14 focused tests covering: authentication (unauthenticated -> 403 from HTTPBearer auto_error, employee -> 403), response structure (period{start,end,months}, totals{activities,employees,departments_active}, by_department, by_employee, by_month), default months=6, months=3, months=12, clamping (months=999 -> 24, months=0 -> 1, months=-5 -> 1), by_department sorted desc with only count>0, by_employee aggregation across 2 seeded employees (TEST_anly_a, TEST_anly_b) with 7 activities spread across 5 months and 4 departments, by_month chronological order and YYYY-MM format with last entry = current month, cross-sum invariants (totals.activities == sum(by_department) == sum(by_employee) == sum(by_month)), totals.employees == len(by_employee), totals.departments_active == len(by_department), period.start == YYYY-MM-01 for months=1, and absence of MongoDB _id in any field of the JSON response. All 14 new tests PASS (100%). Full regression suite (33 tests including previous 19) also passes 100% in 9s. No issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_analytics correctly clamps months via max(1, min(months, 24)) and uses {'_id': 0} projection, so no ObjectID leaks.

Empty-collection edge case: if a department has zero activities and no items exist in any month, by_employee is []; totals.employees == 0; by_month still returns len=months entries with count=0. Verified implicitly via the sums-equal-totals assertions.

Date-window logic uses string comparison on ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' which is correct only because dates are stored exactly in that format (validated in create_activity model). If ad-hoc dates ever get inserted, this could silently drop them. Not a blocker.
Month-grouping uses a['date'][:7]; harmless because Pydantic accepts any string, but a future date-format validator on ActivityCreate would harden this.
Backend still uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') (pre-existing, flagged in iteration_1).
seed_data_creation: Module-scoped fixtures create two TEST_anly_a/TEST_anly_b employees and 7 activities (الفني x3, المالي x1, السلامة x2, الجودة x1) spread over months back 0/0/1/2/0/3/4 from 2026-06. All activities and employees are deleted in teardown via admin token. No residual data after test run.
